description: Ordered intake policy for changes introduced from upstream/main

priorities.label: Security, data consistency, and bounded resources
priorities.action: Absorb first after focused security, persistence, resource-boundary, and migration review.

priorities.label: PTY, WSL, SSH, and Relay stability
priorities.action: Absorb next with the three-platform PTY/WSL/SSH and Relay contract suites.

priorities.label: Agent recovery and Runtime fixes
priorities.action: Absorb after Runtime RPC, reconnect, and agent-resume contract review.

priorities.label: Performance optimizations
priorities.action: Absorb after benchmark evidence and regression-budget review.

priorities.label: Modular refactoring
priorities.action: Absorb only behind behavior-contract tests and the module split ledger.

priorities.label: Pure upstream product interaction or branding
priorities.action: Absorb when the change does not cross a product-boundary path or maintained HiveCode capability; preserve HiveCode branding and UI while adopting upstream behavior. Require product decision only for explicit boundary conflicts.
